summary: RETEST of the two issues from iteration_visual_bugfix_pipeline_2026_09_12.json. Both fixes confirmed working. (1) Frontend spread-order bug in ChatPanel.jsx handleVisualBugAnalyze — the object now correctly puts `...analysis` FIRST and `status:'done'/name/imageId/imageUrl` AFTER, so backend's status:'analyzed' no longer clobbers the frontend's 'done'. Playwright end-to-end verified: attach PNG → click Find-and-fix pill → VisualBugAnalysisCard mounts → loading state observed → thumbnail rendered → 3 extracted-strings pills ('Submit Payment', 'Checkout', 'Error: failed to load') → defects list rendered → no-candidates fallback rendered (expected because active project 'aurem-demo/frontend' has a revoked GitHub App install). (2) Backend 2MB→10MB middleware ordering fixed: '/api/aurem-dev/visual-bugfix/upload' is now in _BODY_LIMIT_BYPASS_PREFIXES in main.py. Independent live curl verified: 7MB PNG → 200 OK with correct metadata; 14MB PNG → 400 'Image too large (14680072 bytes, max 10485760)' (route's own check, not 413, not a crash). (3) pytest test_visual_bugfix_pipeline_2026_01.py: 13/13 PASSED on stable run (first run had 1 flaky 502 on the upload of test_analyze_with_bogus_project_graceful — reran individually and full suite, both green; not a regression, infra-side transient).
